author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Vibe coding will never go away. 

Yes, you need way more than vibe coding to build a reliable production work.   But after you nail the dark factory using proper engineering disciplines, you move up one abstraction level, you vibe coding the next generation of the factory itself.

You can't build with a spec what you don't know.  You can only vibe code, then see what work and what not.  In the past, we call it tinkering.

comments.text: The idea of "vibe coding" as exploring the unknown before formalization is a useful distinction, suggesting iterative discovery rather than full upfront specification. This reflects how complex systems often evolve, moving from emergent behavior to engineered structure.▶
